scope: Restore short-lived same-tab browser refresh context for an authenticated, consented owner without persisting drafts or conversation content.

implementation.logout_behavior: Remove the refresh key before reload; the pagehide handler cannot recreate it after the session state is cleared.
implementation.record_recovery: Reload the protected conversation before restoring the Discussion local tab and scroll position; unavailable records fall back to Discussion.

steps: Sign in as the development owner and accept processing consent.
Open Settings and scroll near the Runtime instructions/Saved versions/Session content.
Use browser Refresh in that same Chrome tab.
Observe Settings remains selected at the same rendered reading position after the page reloads.
